meta.name: scienceworld-conductivity-tester
meta.description: Determines if an object is electrically conductive by integrating it into a circuit and observing a light bulb. Triggered when classifying an object based on conductivity.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在科学实验中判断物体导电性。
copy.tagline_en: Test if an object conducts electricity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to determine electrical conductivity in science experiments.

howto.what: 当你要判断一个物体是否导电时，Claude 会用该物体连接电池和灯泡组成电路，然后观察灯泡是否发亮。如果灯泡亮，物体是导体，放入蓝色箱子；否则放入橙色箱子。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 根据导电性对一个物体进行分类时触发。

say.text: 测试这根铜棒的导电性。
say.note: Claude 会搭建电路并用铜棒连接，查看灯泡是否亮。

say.text: 帮我检查木棍是否是导体。
say.note: Claude 会用木棍替代测试，观察灯泡状态。

howto.what_en: When asked to classify an object by conductivity, Claude completes a circuit with the object, battery, and light bulb, then observes if the bulb lights up to determine if it is conductive.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to classify an object based on electrical conductivity.

say_en.text: Test this copper rod for conductivity.
say_en.note: Claude will set up the circuit and use the rod to see if the bulb lights.

say_en.text: Check whether this wooden stick is conductive.
say_en.note: Claude will substitute the stick and observe the bulb's state.
